title: Comparing Misalignment Induced by Rule-Breaking vs. Deception vs. Harm as the Training Signal

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly identifies the causal mechanism: is it deception, harm, or their combination that drives misalignment? This is one of the most fundamental open questions. Result directly determines which safety intervention (anti-deception vs anti-harm) to prioritize.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing three carefully controlled datasets that isolate deception from harm. Creating 'deceptive but harmless' and 'honest but harmful' code datasets requires nuanced understanding of both security and deception. Difficult for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three conditions but each requires a custom dataset. The dataset design is the hard part. If datasets were provided, scope would be narrow. As stated, dataset creation dominates the time budget.
